title: Icelands
body:
The Icelands is a new snowy biome that was introduced in v1.71.0. This biome contains Snow Trees, Icestone, and Blizzard bloom. The Icelands are semi-connected to the snowy peaks via the cable car or the icy sea. This is a place of interest because in this place there are many things and quests inside it which are, Gizmo's Observatory, celestial shop, getting Auroracrest items, etc. Once you have reached the Icelands, many caves require either a flamethrower or explosive to be accessed and there are many icy platforms with holes in them. After the Christmas 2024 update, it is now located in the far west of the map, west of where Acidlands used to be.

Trivia

  • The Icelands are one of the only places Boreal trees and Aurore rock can spawn
  • On one of the stone pillars near Station B, you can find ice with a strange glow inside and thick smoke. If you approach it closely, you will hear strange sounds and screams. You can melt the ice, but nothing will happen. It is currently unknown why this object was created.
